question:
Create a new KiCad project named b27 in the project directory and draw its schematic for the following request.

Create the schematic for one mechanical half-plate of the Ghoul keyboard, using the supplied Ghoul footprint library. Include twenty MX-1U-PlateCutout instances and four Drill_5mm screw-hole instances. Use pinless mechanical symbols, with no switches, diodes, power symbols or electrical nets. This task asks for the schematic's mechanical footprint inventory; exact plate outline, key spacing and hole coordinates are not specified.
Local dependencies: Use the project-local footprint library in lib/ under the project directory (Ghoul.pretty); use standard KiCad libraries for everything else.
answer:
Created the [b27 KiCad project](./b27.kicad_pro) and its [mechanical inventory schematic](./b27.kicad_sch).

The schematic contains 20 Ghoul MX-1U plate cutouts and four 5 mm drill holes, using pinless symbols. It has no electrical nets. Symbol positions are illustrative, not a plate layout.
